drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Attached are our initial comments and proposed revisions to the Commercial Lease Agreement. We have added placeholders for the Tenant identity and Base Rent, clarified commencement mechanics, and proposed a consent standard for assignments so the provision is commercially workable.

Please confirm the correct Tenant legal name, monthly Base Rent, Commencement Date, and any building-specific rules or exhibits you want incorporated.

Best,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: PARTIES. This Lease is between Calder Properties, as landlord (the "Landlord"), and [TENANT LEGAL NAME], as tenant (the "Tenant").
edits.name: Clarify parties and add tenant placeholder

edits.text: 1. PREMISES. The Landlord leases to the Tenant the premises located at 400 Harbor Street, consisting of approximately [____] rentable square feet, as more particularly described or depicted on Exhibit A (the "Premises"), together with the non-exclusive right to use common areas serving the Premises in accordance with this Lease and the rules and regulations applicable to the property.
edits.name: Define premises and common area rights

edits.text: 2. RENT. The Tenant shall pay monthly base rent in the amount of USD [____] (the "Base Rent"), in advance on the first day of each calendar month during the Term. If the Commencement Date is not the first day of a calendar month, Base Rent for the partial first month shall be prorated on a daily basis.
edits.name: Add rent mechanics and business placeholder

edits.text: 3. TERM. The lease term is sixty (60) months, commencing on [COMMENCEMENT DATE] (the "Commencement Date") and expiring on the last day of the sixtieth (60th) full calendar month thereafter, unless earlier terminated in accordance with this Lease. Landlord shall deliver possession of the Premises to Tenant on or before the Commencement Date in broom-clean condition, free of occupants and personal property, and in compliance with applicable law.
edits.name: Clarify term and delivery condition

edits.text: 4. ASSIGNMENT. The Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublease all or any portion of the Premises without the Landlord's prior written consent, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Tenant may assign this Lease or sublease all or any portion of the Premises without Landlord's consent to an affiliate, successor by merger, consolidation, reorganization, or purchaser of substantially all of Tenant's assets, provided that Tenant gives Landlord written notice and the transferee assumes Tenant's obligations under this Lease in writing.
edits.name: Add reasonable consent standard and permitted transfers

edits.text: Open business point: please confirm the agreed monthly Base Rent and whether any rent abatement, escalations, operating expenses, taxes, or security deposit provisions should be added.
edits.name: Rent economics comment

drafter.private_reasoning: I preserved Tenant protections where possible while moving the draft toward closure: added placeholders for Tenant identity and economics, accepted NNN structure in principle subject to exhibit/amounts, added commencement safeguards, softened security deposit/escalations as bracketed business terms, and narrowed assignment consent with reasonable conditions while retaining affiliate/successor transfers without consent. I did not disclose any unrelated confidential bottom-line information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Attached are Tenant’s Round 2 edits. We have incorporated the Tenant legal-name placeholder, added the NNN framework and the proposed security deposit/escalation mechanics as bracketed business points, and revised commencement to account for the earlier of the fixed date or Tenant’s occupancy/opening, provided Landlord has delivered the Premises as required. We also revised the assignment section to preserve Landlord’s approval rights and reasonable financial/operational conditions, while maintaining customary no-consent transfers for affiliates, successors, and asset-sale transactions.

Please confirm the Premises rentable square footage, the proposed monthly Base Rent number, and any agreed abatement or Landlord work exhibit so we can finalize the remaining blanks.

edits.text: PARTIES. This Lease is between Calder Properties, as landlord (the "Landlord"), and [TENANT FULL LEGAL NAME], a [JURISDICTION AND ENTITY TYPE] (the "Tenant").
edits.name: Parties - Tenant identity placeholder

edits.text: Tenant to provide full legal name, jurisdiction, and entity type before execution.
edits.name: Tenant identity confirmation

edits.text: 2. RENT; ADDITIONAL RENT; SECURITY DEPOSIT. The Tenant shall pay monthly base rent in the amount of USD [____] (the "Base Rent"), in advance on the first day of each calendar month during the Term. Beginning on each annual anniversary of the Commencement Date, Base Rent shall increase by three percent (3%) over the Base Rent payable immediately before such anniversary. This Lease is intended to be triple-net, and Tenant shall pay, as Additional Rent, Tenant’s proportionate share of operating expenses, real estate taxes, insurance charges, utilities, and other charges expressly identified in this Lease or its exhibits, subject to reasonable supporting documentation and customary exclusions to be set forth in Exhibit [__]. Tenant shall deposit with Landlord, upon execution of this Lease, a security deposit equal to [three (3)] months of then-current Base Rent, to be held and applied in accordance with applicable law and this Lease. If the Commencement Date is not the first day of a calendar month, Base Rent and Additional Rent for the partial first month shall be prorated on a daily basis. No rent abatement shall apply except as expressly set forth in Exhibit [__] or another written amendment signed by both parties.
edits.name: Rent - NNN, escalation, deposit, abatement

edits.text: Open business point: Landlord to insert proposed monthly Base Rent. Parties to confirm whether the security deposit remains three months’ Base Rent and whether any abatement, free-rent period, cap, exclusion, or Landlord work credit will be included in an exhibit.
edits.name: Rent economics confirmation

edits.text: 3. TERM; COMMENCEMENT. The lease term is sixty (60) months, commencing on the earlier of (a) [FIXED COMMENCEMENT DATE] and (b) the date Tenant first occupies the Premises or opens for business in the Premises (the "Commencement Date"), and expiring on the last day of the sixtieth (60th) full calendar month thereafter, unless earlier terminated in accordance with this Lease; provided, however, that the Commencement Date shall not occur before Landlord has delivered possession of the Premises to Tenant in broom-clean condition, free of occupants and personal property, with all Landlord work expressly required under this Lease or Exhibit [__] substantially complete, and otherwise in compliance with applicable law. Landlord and Tenant shall execute a commencement date memorandum confirming the Commencement Date and expiration date promptly after the Commencement Date is determined.
edits.name: Term - commencement trigger and delivery condition

edits.text: Open business point: confirm fixed commencement date and whether any Landlord work/delivery exhibit applies. Tenant has accepted the earlier-of structure subject to actual delivery and required work completion.
edits.name: Commencement confirmation

edits.text: 4. ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLETTING. Except as expressly provided below, Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublease all or any portion of the Premises without Landlord’s prior written consent, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed. Landlord may condition consent on reasonable financial, operational, and use-related requirements, including that the proposed transferee have financial capacity reasonably sufficient to perform the tenant obligations being transferred, that the proposed use be permitted under this Lease and applicable law, that the proposed transfer not adversely affect the building or other tenants in any material respect, and that the transferee assume in writing the applicable obligations under this Lease. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Tenant may assign this Lease or sublease all or any portion of the Premises without Landlord’s consent to an affiliate, successor by merger, consolidation, reorganization, or purchaser of substantially all of Tenant’s assets, provided that Tenant gives Landlord written notice, the transferee assumes Tenant’s obligations under this Lease in writing, and the transfer is not undertaken principally to avoid Tenant’s obligations under this Lease. No assignment or sublease shall release Tenant from liability under this Lease unless Landlord expressly agrees in writing.
edits.name: Assignment - consent rights and permitted transfers

edits.text: Revised to preserve Landlord’s approval rights and reasonable financial/operational conditions while retaining customary permitted transfers without consent.
